name: M3_OIS100MI_Confirm
description: Confirm batch customer orders and create the final customer order from a temporary batch order. The Confirm operation runs the standard customer order processing logic for a batch order created via batch entry (for example after creating a batch header and lines) and validates all header, line, and credit information. When processing succeeds, it converts the temporary batch order number into a real customer order and returns the resulting order number together with a processing status. Confirm can run either interactively (online) or as a background job, controlled by the confirmation type input. An order is regarded as fully completed only when the returned status code is 90.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Temporary customer order number (batch order number) to confirm and release into a final customer order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the batch customer order is registered, if different from the default company.

inputParameters.name: CTYP
inputParameters.description: Confirmation processing type controlling whether the batch order is processed interactively or via batch and whether an order number is returned.

outputParameters.name: ORNO
outputParameters.description: Final customer order number created from the batch order, or a reserved order number when processed in batch mode.

outputParameters.name: STAT
outputParameters.description: Processing status of the batch order after confirmation, where 90 means the order is completed and other values indicate validation, credit, or processing issues.
